caption: The drawing depicts a single object, which is a rocking horse with an arched metal rocking base. The horse is painted mostly in faded pink or light red with significant patches where the paint has worn off, revealing a lighter or possibly wooden color underneath. The mane and tail are not detailed, and the saddle appears to be brown with a slight sheen, complete with metallic studs along its edge. The bridle is also brown and loops from the mouth area up around the head. The rocking base consists of two curved, dark brown metal bars supporting the body of the horse. The background is blank and neutral, with no other objects or scenery present, highlighting the rocking horse centrally within the composition.
title: Rock Horse
